rubric.role_summary: Founding product designer for software used by local governments. The role is initially hands-on, shaping complex workflows, AI experiences, and the design system before building a design function.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Founding product designer for software used by local governments. The role is initially hands-on, shaping complex workflows, AI experiences, and the design system before building a design function.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Hands-on product design experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Track record of designing products for complex use cases.
- Hands-on product design experience taking ambiguous problems through to polished experiences.
- Ability to establish a design system for product teams.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas. Explicit work-attendance terms (city labels use the area interpretation above): We have a hybrid work culture that combines regular in-person collaboration at our New York City office (3+ days per week) with flexibility to work remotely.

must_haves.source_quote: You’re an exceptional hands-on product designer who can take an ambiguous problem through to a polished experience

preferences.requirement: Track record of designing products for complex use cases.
preferences.source_quote: You have a track record of designing intuitive, beautiful products for complex use cases.

preferences.requirement: Hands-on product design experience taking ambiguous problems through to polished experiences.
preferences.source_quote: You’re an exceptional hands-on product designer who can take an ambiguous problem through to a polished experience

preferences.requirement: Ability to establish a design system for product teams.
preferences.source_quote: You can establish a design system that helps teams move faster without letting the system become more important than the product.

location.requirement_text: Location: New York metropolitan area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
source_quotes: We have a hybrid work culture that combines regular in-person collaboration at our New York City office (3+ days per week) with flexibility to work remotely.

soft_requirements: Product judgment, including challenging assumptions and simplifying workflows.
Active use of AI and thoughtful opinions about AI software experiences.
Clear communication with founders, product managers, engineers, and customers.
Interest in starting as a hands-on individual contributor and eventually building and leading a design team.
Ability to understand government staff and residents without prior govtech experience.
Alignment with the employer’s core values.

interpretation.user_instruction: for multiple locations, accept either one, broaden the area to the general area if it's a specific city, if remote + a location, please force them into the location, follow the text rather than the metadata, for x-y years exp, unbound the top but evaluate obviously overqualified candidates as failures in the final fit eval, other than that, assume the less strict of interpretations (eg masters required versus masters or phd, eval as if masters or phd)

Make these changes to every role.
